recognize_zh: 低倍下組織碎片左側為密集的淋巴漿細胞浸潤，右側則逐漸轉為粉紅色膠原纖維與梭形細胞構成的纖維化區域，呈現發炎細胞浸潤合併明顯硬化（sclerosis）的反應性淋巴結型態。
features: Fragment of lymphoid tissue with a dense mononuclear inflammatory infiltrate on the left
Sharp transition to a sclerotic zone of pink collagen with streaming spindle fibroblasts on the right
Infiltrating lymphocytes and plasma cells extending into the fibrous tissue
Scattered vessels and paler histiocyte-rich areas; no discrete follicles visible in this fragment
Small, bland nuclei without sheets of large atypical cells at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows a fragment of lymphoid tissue containing a dense, predominantly small mononuclear infiltrate that transitions to a sclerotic zone of collagen with streaming spindle cells, likely representing capsular or perinodal fibrosis. Inflammatory cells, including lymphocytes and plasma cells, extend into the fibrous stroma. Lymphoid follicles are not well seen in this fragment and there are no sheets of atypical large cells at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphadenitis with sclerosis and plasmacytosis; in the appropriate clinical context syphilitic lymphadenitis should be excluded with Treponema immunostain and serology.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis type
ddx.vs: NSCHL shows broad birefringent collagen bands encircling nodules that contain lacunar Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+), which are not evident here.
IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with abundant IgG4+ plasma cells and obliterative phlebitis, requiring IgG4/IgG immunostains to separate from syphilis.

ddx.dx: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor / inflammatory pseudotumor of lymph node
ddx.vs: Inflammatory pseudotumor centers on the hilum and trabeculae with a spindle-cell proliferation expanding the node, and syphilis must be excluded by Treponema staining.
